details.releaseNotesExcerpt: ## Recursive Flint [Flint](https://ollama.com/library/flint) brings Recursive's coding model to Ollama. It is designed for the work coding agents do across a repository: understanding unfamiliar code, tracing bugs, implementing features, and adding tests. Reasoning, multi-turn tool use, and a 262K-token context window support longer tasks across files and tool interactions. Flint is an Apache 2.0-licensed, 40B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with approximately 2.5B parameters active per token. In its [release evaluations](https://huggingface.co/RecursiveSI/flint#evaluation), Recursive reports 54.9% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 74.2% on SWE-bench Verified. ```sh ollama run flint ``` Note: Flint is supported on MacOS. Other GPU support will be enabled in a subsequent release. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v0.40.7..

details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> llama: create new fused op for QSA mask (#30640) * llama: create new fused op for QSA scoring * enroll glm5.3-next too * tests : initialize the remaining tensors in test_kpool_mask The harness sentinels were left uninitialized, so leftover memory could read as NaN and fail the NaN check. * ggml: generalize the k-pool mask op into ggml_top_k_mask The k-pool mask op only covered the pooled QSA selection of qwen4exp and glm5-next, while the DSA models and the DeepSeek V4 CSA build the same top-k mask by hand with fill, set_rows and add. ggml_top_k_mask(mask, top_k, score, blocks, extra) keeps the mask cells of the live picks and the extra cells, and sets the rest to -inf.
